notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
Greetings Players!

The Holidays are here and we are proud to bring you all a solid update to Void Warfare for the season!

Fixes include:
-Player Controls have been updated. Better Sensitivity and controller mapping has been added.
-Complete Controller Support from start of the game to the end of the game.
-Controller Remapping including Sensitivity Settings from the in game Pause Menu.
-Added Mass to Ships for Rotate, removed the turning factors of Ships making them turn more realistically and not evade missiles as often unless very small.
-Lowered Regen Rates and Gun Resource on Decimator Class to further balance the harder missions.
-Floating Aim has been turned off to allow for better Inversion of the Pitch Controls. The Aimer is frozen in the center.
-Any Control type can be used from start to finish without having to unplug one in favor of another.
-Zela Behemoth had a small issue on it's Armor position making it hard to fight from behind, this has been fixed.
-Fixed a Mission's music that didn't loop.

Thank you to all who have and will purchase Void Warfare! We hope it brings some extra fun to your Holiday Season!

Sincerely,
XMX Studios

notes.title: Update Incoming for the Holidays and Sale!
notes.notes:
Greetings Players!

It is the Holiday Season! We are proud to have made some major quality of life improvements to Void Warfare as well as further Balancing of the game play for all those who have purchased the title or plan on doing so during the holidays! These changes will go live this Friday on the 10th of December!

Changes to the Game will Include:
-Complete Controller Support from Start of the game until you put it down.
-Can use either control type (KB/Mouse, Controller) from start to finish without needing to unplug a -Controller to allow for Mouse Aim.
-Floating Aimer has been turned off to aid with Inversion of Pitch.
-Sensitivity has been further checked as well as allowing Sensitivity Control Change in Remapping.
-Controller remapping added to the Pause Menu.
-Power Plants are lowered in output on the Decimator Class Ships, this is done to further balance the difficulty in the harder game modes as they were very easy to beat with the last update.
-A music track not looping has been fixed.
-Zela Behemoth's armor needed a slight placement adjustment to fix it being hard to hit from behind.

A Sale will be occuring between the 18th through the 1st or so. Keep an eye out if you're interested!

Best Wishes for the Holidays!

XMX Studios.

notes.title: Major Update!
notes.notes:
Greetings Players!

We are proud to announce the arrival of many quality of life settings that were previously lacking from Void Warfare.

Main Menu Settings allow you to control the volume levels individually for Music, Menu and SFX. 

Three ships have been added to the game for use on Death Match, Wave Endurance and Battle Royale Game Modes. These ships are medium sized, heavily armed, Shielded, Hulled and have strong Power Plants to regenerate Hull and Shields when not taking damage. These have been added to off balance the unrealistic expectation of beating many of the later Death Matches, Wave Endurance and Battle Royale Game Modes with standard ships. Death Match Modes are good warm ups for those Prototypes before tacking the more intense Wave Endurance and Battle Royale Modes.  

Aim Assist for all Gun Weapons has seen the radius increase from the target to aid in Auto Aim.
Missile Lock on radius has been increased to allow for a larger sight angle to keep locking onto a target.
Gun and Missile range have both been increased to 1500.
Turning Factors are decreased largely as they were conflicting with the Aim Sensitivity. Ship lines are now a slight bit faster on turn radius to show enhancements of technology. 
Aiming Sensitivity has been tested between the slowest ship and the fastest - all are smooth and comfortable to aim with. 

Leaderboards have been reset. 

We will keep listening to feedback and information you have for us to ensure we deliver to you an enjoyable title. If you have any desires for changes - please do start a discussion in the Community Hub about what you might like to see. We would be happy to listen to any feedback or requests and see what we can make happen.

Thank you to those who have purchased Void Warfare! We hope this update will boost all of your enjoyment when you play the title.

Sincerely,
XMX Studios

notes.title: Upcoming Major Update!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Players!

Shortly will be a Major Update to the Game Mechanics.
Below is a List of all things that have been added or updated.

Adding Main Menu Settings
	Music Volume
        Menu Volume
	Sound Effects Volume

Adding 3 new ship Prototypes for the Death Match, Wave Endurance and Battle Royale Game Modes. These Ships are all fast, medium sized but very heavily armed, armored and shielded. They also come with Power Plants to regenerate their Shields and Gun Weapons at a more significant rate. It also allows for Active Hull Repairs. No extra mechanics are needed for the regeneration of Hull - it will happen naturally if you're not being damaged over time.  

Updates:
Widen Missile lock on Radius and Range. 
Gun/Missile Range increased to 1500. 
Aim Assist Angle and Distance Increased for Guns. 
Turn Rates of ships has been largely decreased as they were too erratic for the Sensitivity.
Aim sensitivity has been further tweaked to be smooth from the slowest to fastest ship.

As many of the Death Match, Wave Endurance and Battle Royale modes were exceptionally hard(If not outright unbeatable) - the Prototype Helino, Xeosi and Modra ships will allow for completion of the game with much less stress involved in getting there.

Before it goes live - we will do a full reset of all Leaderboards; Achievements are all staying as is, if you earned those you keep them. 

We hope these recent updates to the game are received well as we continue to grow this title into a more enjoyable experience for all.

Thank you all for your purchase! We will continue to do all we can to improve your enjoyment and experience.

Sincerely,
XMX Studios

notes.title: Fix Patch
notes.notes:
Achievements/Stats send to server were temporarily turned off between the last update until this one. Apologies - it has been fixed. Ascik Behemoth has been fixed; Armor takes damage again.
Many of the ships stats have changed to make larger ships move slower and turn slower than smaller ships. This scales upwards from Ascik through Ogin to reflect the better technologies of later ships. 
Controller sensitivity update to further allow for better controls when aiming.

notes.title: Control Sensitivity Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Players!

Feedback has been received, controls being a major one. We have updated the game with a much easier sensitivity on both the mouse and controller to aim. It was tested going through the Ralloz and Ogin Sectors and both were much much better at staying on point. Mouse Aim especially is really smooth and felt easy to follow along with due to the wandering reticel. 

Thank you again for your purchase and the feedback - what you all say matters in the end. We hope this helps improve your experience. Any further feedback is appreciated!

Sincerely,
XMX Studios
